reel.caption:
At 03:17 UTC, the signal appeared.

We thought the source was somewhere beyond the Moon.

Then the Moon moved in front of it.

That changed everything.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // CS-001
reel.pinned_comment:
One question remains:

Did we detect it...

or did it detect us first?

still.caption:
At 03:17 UTC, Earth received a signal from deep space.

At first, scientists believed it was coming from an unknown object beyond the Moon.

They were wrong.

The object was not beyond the Moon.

The Moon was in front of it.

Whatever produced the signal was so large that our instruments could not determine where it ended.

For seventeen seconds, it remained perfectly still.

Then one part of its surface opened.

Something inside was looking directly at Earth.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // TRANSMISSION 000
still.pinned_comment:
One question remains:

Did we detect it...

or did it detect us first?

reel.caption:
The Moon moved.

At first, we thought the darkness behind it was empty space.

Then it opened its eye.

And looked directly at Earth.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // CS-002
reel.pinned_comment:
TRANSMISSION NOTE:

The eye did not follow the Moon.

It followed Earth.

No further movement was recorded.

still.caption:
The Moon was never the problem.

During analysis of CS-002, one frame revealed something impossible.

The darkness behind the Moon had structure.

Then the eye opened.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // ARCHIVE FRAME CS-002
still.pinned_comment:
ARCHIVE NOTE:

This frame was captured moments before the eye fully emerged.

Its scale remains undetermined.

Earth is visible below for reference.

episodes.title: THE SHADOW THAT TURNED

reel.caption:
It was already moving past Earth.

No signal.
No reaction.
No sign that it had noticed us.

Then the shadow stopped.

And turned back.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // CS-003
reel.pinned_comment:
TRANSMISSION NOTE:

The object changed direction only once.

Its new trajectory pointed directly toward Earth.

episodes.title: EARTH BETWEEN GODS
episodes.still_caption:
Earth was not the target.

Two colossal forms crossed the same region of space from opposite directions.

Neither changed course.

Earth was simply between them.

Both entities appeared to be facing each other.

episodes.title: THE PLANET EATER
episodes.still_caption:
We logged it as a dead world.

No atmosphere. No rotation. No measurable heat.

Then another planet passed too close.

The surface opened.

It is moving inward.

episodes.title: IT DIDN'T NOTICE US
episodes.still_caption:
For hours, it moved past Earth without reacting.

We thought that meant we were too small to matter.

Then one part of the structure turned.

Only slightly.

It was enough.

episodes.still_pinned:

New orientation: Earth.

episodes.title: THE MOON WAS IN ITS HAND
episodes.still_caption:
The Moon disappeared for eleven seconds.

Not behind a cloud.
Not behind Earth.

Behind fingers.

episodes.still_pinned:

Whatever surrounded it matched its motion perfectly.

Every pulse arrived at the same interval.

Then the interval changed.

It matched a heartbeat.

episodes.title: THE FACE INSIDE THE NEBULA
episodes.still_caption:
At first, the nebula looked ordinary.

Then its clouds began forming the same features in every wavelength.

Eyes. A brow. A face.

The nebula was not surrounding it.

The nebula was part of it.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // ARCHIVE FRAME CS-011
episodes.still_pinned:
SPECTRAL NOTE:

The facial structure appears in infrared, visible light, and radio mapping.

It is not a visual illusion.

episodes.title: THE WORLD THAT OPENED ITS EYE
episodes.still_caption:
We had mapped the planet for three months.

The surface never changed.

Then an entire hemisphere opened.

It had been looking away from us.

episodes.still_pinned:
PLANETARY NOTE:

No tectonic event explains the opening.

The structure beneath the surface moved as one piece.

Something was hiding there.

episodes.title: THE STARS MOVED FIRST
episodes.still_caption:
The stars shifted before anything else moved.

At first, we blamed the telescope.

Then entire constellations bent around the same invisible shape.

The sky was outlining a body.

episodes.still_caption:
Saturn has always had rings.

This one was not there yesterday.

It crossed the planet at the wrong angle.

And it kept moving after Saturn stopped.

Not a portal.
Not a storm.

The edges moved like a jaw.

And Neptune was drifting toward it.

We see it only because it removes the stars behind it.

episodes.title: THE HAND UNDER EARTH'S SHADOW
episodes.still_caption:

At first, it looked like part of the planet's shadow.

Then the shadow separated into fingers.

Something had been underneath us the entire time.

episodes.still_pinned:

It was not a star.

episodes.title: SOMETHING SAT BEHIND THE SUN
episodes.still_caption:
For three minutes, the Sun's corona formed a perfect outline.

A head. Shoulders. A body.

It was not crossing the Sun.

It was sitting behind it.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // ARCHIVE FRAME CS-021
episodes.still_pinned:
SOLAR OBSERVATION:

The silhouette remained fixed while the Sun rotated.

Its distance is still unknown.

episodes.title: EARTH HEARD IT BREATHE
episodes.still_caption:
Every radio telescope on Earth recorded the same sound.

A slow intake.
A pause.
A deeper release.

The pattern repeated from beyond the atmosphere.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // ARCHIVE FRAME CS-022
episodes.still_pinned:
ACOUSTIC NOTE:

The signal is below normal human hearing.

When accelerated, the pattern resembles breathing.

episodes.title: IT WORE THE ECLIPSE
episodes.still_caption:
The eclipse began exactly on schedule.

What appeared around it did not.

The corona outlined something larger than the darkness itself.

It was wearing the eclipse like a crown.

episodes.still_pinned:

It does not explain the structure surrounding it.

episodes.still_caption:
Jupiter's storm changed shape overnight.

The clouds tightened into a perfect ring.

Then the center focused.

The Great Red Spot was never looking at us.

This was.

episodes.title: IT FOLDED SPACE AROUND EARTH
episodes.still_caption:
The stars did not disappear.

They bent.

Entire galaxies curved around Earth as if space itself had been pinched inward.

Whatever surrounded us was not moving through space.

It was moving space around us.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // ARCHIVE FRAME CS-026
episodes.still_pinned:
GRAVITY NOTE:

No matching mass has been detected.

The distortion is centered on Earth, not on the entity.

episodes.title: THE MOON CHANGED ORBIT FOR IT
episodes.still_caption:

Then it shifted again.

Both corrections pointed toward the same object.

The Moon was making room for it.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // ARCHIVE FRAME CS-027
episodes.still_pinned:
ORBITAL NOTE:

No known gravitational event explains the change.

Earth's orbit remained untouched.

episodes.title: THE SIGNAL CAME FROM BELOW
episodes.still_caption:

Then one arrived from the opposite direction.

Not from deep space.

From beneath Earth.

episodes.still_pinned:

The signal passed upward through Earth before reaching the satellites.

Its origin remains below the mapped crust.

episodes.title: IT FINALLY MOVED
episodes.still_caption:
Every previous encounter had one thing in common.

They watched.
They waited.
They remained almost perfectly still.

At 03:17 UTC, that changed.

It finally moved.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // SEASON ARCHIVE CS-029
episodes.still_pinned:
FINAL TRANSMISSION NOTE:

The movement was not directed toward the Moon.
Not toward the Sun.

The trajectory is Earth.
